title: Use configured provider model for connection test
context: Settings tests chat completion through the active provider runtime but currently sends the synthetic model ID provider-connection-test, which may not exist on the provider and can report a false connection failure.
goal: Exercise the active runtime with its configured model identity so the test validates the same provider/model route that Chat can actually use.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass the active provider runtime or send a direct alternate network request.
Do not log, expose, or persist API credentials.
Do not change provider selection, endpoint, or credential storage behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Connection test obtains the model ID from the active runtime identity rather than a synthetic placeholder.
Missing runtime or model fails closed and reports connection failure.
Successful result still requires a non-empty completion response.
Existing provider credential and connection-state behavior remains unchanged.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Review that test model ID matches runtime.identity.models.first.id
recovery: Revert the single task commit if connection testing no longer uses the active runtime model.
